shared_elements: quadruped with open mouth / feline-like head
low relief carving on a flat surface
register-like horizontal division of the field
justification: Both surfaces carry low-relief animals in profile arranged in horizontal bands, and each includes a snarling quadruped with an open, fanged mouth. Beyond that they diverge sharply: A is a coherent naturalistic narrative of human archers in a wheeled chariot drawn by horses attacking lions, while B is a schematic, non-narrative assemblage of stylised birds, a row of repeated arched/loop signs and abstract motifs with no human figures, vehicles or action.
